summary: First-run end-to-end test for Rane Management Consultant site. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass covering leads CRUD, admin auth, status updates with persistence, public stats and validation. Frontend: 8/8 marketing pages navigate without console errors, Home hero + stats visible, Projects filters work for all 7 categories, Contact form submits with success toast and clears, Careers Apply pre-fills role and submits successfully (lead_type=career), Admin login rejects wrong password, accepts correct one, status PATCH and DELETE work, logout returns to login form.

issues: Hero background image (unsplash photo-1545208031-40409a47dd02) sometimes fails/slow to load and the alt text 'Infrastructure corridor drone view' becomes visible at top-left of the viewport on initial render. Consider preloading, using a local/static image, or hiding the img alt when offscreen.

Projects page hero image (people in a meeting room) is unrelated to the page topic 'Mandates that shaped India's infrastructure' — consider replacing with land/infrastructure imagery for brand coherence.

Filter 'Government' returns 0 visible cards — none of the seeded sample projects carry the 'government' category, which makes the button appear non-functional. Either tag at least one project with 'government' or hide/disable the filter when the category is empty.

action_items: (Minor) Fix flaky hero image on Home so alt text never leaks visually — switch to a self-hosted image or use a background-image CSS approach.
(Minor) Add at least one 'Government' tagged project so the corresponding Projects filter shows results.
(Minor) Replace Projects hero image with an infrastructure/land-themed image.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: created_at stored as ISO string but re-parsed as datetime on every read — consider storing as native BSON date for proper indexing/sorting (current sort works because ISO strings are lex-sortable, OK for now).
server.py uses single hard-coded ADMIN_PASSWORD env; fine for MVP but flagging for future role-based auth.
ADMIN_PASSWORD has a default fallback ('rmc-admin-2025') in code which weakens security if env not set — consider failing fast when missing in production.
Frontend uses a global admin password sent as header on every request from browser/localStorage — acceptable for MVP but should move to short-lived JWT before production.
test_credentials: Admin password: rmc-admin-2025 (header x-admin-password). Confirmed working from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Test created 2 leads via UI (contact + careers forms) and 1 via API (then deleted in cleanup). One additional lead remains in DB from UI tests with status='qualified' — main agent may purge if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows green. Reusable pytest suite: /app/backend/tests/test_leads_api.py (16 cases, ~1.3s). Frontend nav uses data-testid kebab-case (nav-link-*, contact-*, careers-*, admin-*, filter-{slug}, lead-row-{id}, status-{id}, delete-{id}). Admin page is outside Shell at /admin and uses sidebar buttons filter-all/new/contacted/qualified/closed.
